preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is between 1 and 20 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between 0 and 400 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vi <= n and 1 <= ui <= n for vi, ui in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two nodes, both of which are between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Yes' if any(all(i in path for i in range(1, n+1)) for path in paths) else stdout == 'No'
postconditions.description: The output is 'Yes' if there exists a Hamiltonian path in the graph, otherwise 'No'.
